title: Chunked Checksum
prompt: Implement file_hash(path) computing the SHA-256 hex digest of a file by reading it in 64 KB chunks (never the whole file). Return the hexdigest string.

tests.name: digest of known content
tests.code:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / 'f.bin'
p.write_bytes(b'hello world')
import hashlib
assert file_hash(p) == hashlib.sha256(b'hello world').hexdigest()
tests.hint: h.update(chunk) in a loop, then h.hexdigest().

tests.name: empty file has the empty digest
tests.code:
import hashlib, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()) / 'e.bin'
p.write_bytes(b'')
assert file_hash(p) == hashlib.sha256(b'').hexdigest()
tests.hint: Zero chunks still produce a valid digest.

tests.name: reads in blocks, not all at once
tests.code:
import hashlib
assert 'read()' not in code, 'f.read() with no size slurps the whole file - read fixed-size blocks'
assert 'sha256' in code
tests.hint: f.read() with no argument reads everything; pass a block size.
